blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – The provincial government of Zamboanga del Sur launched its tourism website as it activated its Tourist Police Unit on Tuesday to boost local tourism and enhance visitor security. The dual initiatives were formally launched during the World Tourism Day celebration at the Pavilion Hall, Provincial Government Center in Barangay
